description: This file defines classes and functions related to manifest items and test representations for web platform tests, including URL-based tests, reftests, manual tests, and support files.

classes.name: ManifestItem
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a generic manifest item with properties like id, path, and methods for JSON serialization.

classes.name: URLManifestItem
classes.description: Represents a manifest item identified by a URL, with support for URL joining and JSON serialization.

classes.name: TestharnessTest
classes.description: A specific type of URLManifestItem representing a testharness test, with optional timeout.

classes.name: RefTestNode
classes.description: Represents a reftest node with references, timeout, viewport size, and dpi, capable of converting to other test types.

classes.name: RefTest
classes.description: A subclass of RefTestNode representing a reftest.

classes.name: ManualTest
classes.description: A URLManifestItem representing a manual test.

classes.name: ConformanceCheckerTest
classes.description: A URLManifestItem representing a conformance checker test.

classes.name: VisualTest
classes.description: A URLManifestItem representing a visual test.

classes.name: WebdriverSpecTest
classes.description: A URLManifestItem representing a WebDriver specification test with optional timeout.

classes.name: SupportFile
classes.description: A ManifestItem representing a support file with an id property.

methods.name: get_source_file
methods.description: Function to retrieve or create a SourceFile object from source_files dictionary.
